tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar, list rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented controls, the stat strip inside a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card outlines, dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and toggles (at least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, units, timestamps, labels. On surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and fiuto-soft.

tokens.name: fiuto
tokens.usage: The brand amber. Fills only: the primary button, the top-score badge, the dot of the logo, the active tab indicator. Text on it is on-fiuto.

tokens.name: fiuto-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for highlighted deals and the brand callout; text on it is ink or fiuto-ink.

tokens.name: fiuto-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text or icon: links, the score number outside its badge. On surface, surface-raised and fiuto-soft.

tokens.name: on-fiuto
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a fiuto fill (primary button label, score badge). Never white.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive margin and prices under market value, as text with a + sign. On surface, surface-raised and gain-soft.

tokens.name: gain-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a positive-margin pill; text on it is gain.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative margin, prices over market value, destructive actions, as text with a − sign. On surface, surface-raised and loss-soft.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a negative-margin pill; text on it is loss.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 9:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-series
tokens.usage: Bars and lines of a single-series chart, on surface-raised (9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasized marks when one value is highlighted in ink (at least 3.4:1 on surface-raised in both themes).

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one headline number of a screen: estimated margin on the ad detail, total margin on Acquisti. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Prices and margins in cards and stat strips. Tabular figures.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles (make, model, engine), section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, ad descriptions, form values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Metadata rows, chips, button labels, form labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above a figure. Set text-transform: uppercase; always in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, space inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between metadata items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top of a screen above the title; empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, inputs, the score badge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, photos inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the app icon tile, large callouts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the floating action bar only. Cards have no shadow: they sit on line hairlines.
